newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Email says profit boost helped share price.
newsitem.headline: Email says profit boost helped share price.

text.p: Electrical consumer goods manufacturer Email Ltd said on Tuesday that the sharp rise in its share price last month was a reaction to the company's 1996/97 profit result.
The Australian Stock Exchange had asked the company to explain the rise in its share price to A$4.85 on June 27 from A$4.00 on June 6.

"The company believes that the market has responded positively to the full year profit results which were announced on June 5, 1997 and to general economic conditions over which the company has no control. The company cannot offer any other explanation for the price change in the company's securities," it said.
Email shares ended 18 cents lower at A$4.56 on Tuesday in an overall weaker market.
Ratings agency Standard and Poor's Corp placed Email on creditwatch negative on Monday, citing the company's debt levels.
